claims.evidence: The witness report shows IBC water storage tanks and other plastic tanks; it does not show any white sand or any cholesterol/chemical-resistance claim.

risks.risk: Unknown grade/previous contents (food-grade vs chemical-grade). If previously used for chemicals, it may be unsafe for potable water and lowers value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the tank label/markings (food-grade/chemical-grade), or a close-up of any previous-use/inspection stickers and the outlet area showing compatibility.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed for potable/food use (worst case: chemical/unknown prior use).

risks.risk: Capacity/size not readable, so the exact liters per IBC is unknown; pricing depends heavily on size.
risks.proof: A close, readable shot of the capacity marking (e.g., liters/volume) on the IBC or its specification plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest common/assumed size for IBCs until capacity is proven.

risks.risk: Condition risk: possible cracks/leaks/UV brittleness in the plastic and fittings; cage rust and structural integrity are not shown.
risks.proof: Video/clip showing the tank surface in good light (front/back/sides) plus a close-up of the outlet/valve area and cage joints; ideally a leak test demonstration or water-fill proof.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used and potentially needing repair/with leak risk (worst case: treat as not guaranteed watertight).

risks.risk: Missing or non-functional outlet components (valve/tap/caps) not confirmed; incomplete fittings reduce usability.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the outlet valve/tap, caps, and any included hoses/adapters; show that the valve opens/closes (short clip).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown functionality (worst case: assume valve/caps may be missing or faulty).

risks.risk: Quantity and lot completeness unclear (how many IBCs exactly, and whether accessories are included).
risks.proof: A wide shot counting all IBC tanks in the lot, plus a checklist photo of included accessories (taps, caps, pallets/frames).
risks.if_unproven: Price for the smallest clearly confirmed quantity and exclude unproven accessories.

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of each IBC’s label/markings showing food-grade vs chemical-grade and any inspection/serial info.
Send a readable photo of the IBC capacity (liters) for at least one tank (and confirm the rest match).
Send close-ups and a short video of the outlet/valve area showing it is complete and functional (open/close).
Send photos/video of the plastic body and cage showing no cracks, deformation, or heavy rust; include any signs of leaks.
Confirm the exact number of IBC tanks included and whether any accessories (hoses, taps, caps, pallets) are included.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type (IBC water storage tanks), but key pricing drivers are not verifiable from the report: grade/previous contents, capacity markings, and condition of fittings/cage. Without those, a worst-case price would be too speculative.
